S.I.N. #3

Ultima propunere

K. Bromberg, Maria Dosei (Translator)

4.25
5,845 ratings586 reviews
Rate this book
O noapte furtunoasă.
Un bar plin de călători blocați.
Un singur loc liber, lângă un bărbat misterios, fermecător și irezistibil.

Era ceva la el – felul în care vorbea, privirea lui, care m-a făcut să mă simt vie. Ascultată. Dorită. Ca și cum, pentru prima dată, cineva m-ar fi văzut cu adevărat.

Nu mi-am imaginat nicio clipă că acel străin este Fordham Sharpe, unul dintre cei trei frați Sharpe, moștenitori ai unui imperiu uriaș și scandalos de influent.
Și cu atât mai puțin m-am așteptat să devenim parteneri de afaceri, într-un proiect de transformare a unei pensiuni care părea desprinsă din visurile mele.
Pentru el, eram un teritoriu interzis.
Pentru mine, el era o tentație periculoasă.
Știam amândoi că nu se amestecă afacerile cu plăcerea. Dar, în fiecare zi, atracția devenea imposibil de ignorat.
Ne-am unit forțele pentru a demonstra că putem construi ceva grandios.
Poate, însă, ceea ce aveam de dovedit era cu totul altceva – că amândoi aveam nevoie de același lucru: unul de celălalt.

About the author

K. Bromberg

114 books19.6k followers
New York Times Bestselling author K. Bromberg writes contemporary romance novels that make you work to get your happily ever after. She likes to write strong heroines and damaged heroes, who we love to hate but can’t help but love.

Since publishing her first book on a whim in 2013, Kristy has sold over two million copies of her books across twenty different countries and has landed on the New York Times, USA Today, and Wall Street Journal Bestsellers lists over thirty times.

A mom of three, Kristy finds the only thing harder than finishing the book she’s writing is navigating parenthood during the teenage years (send more wine!). She loves dogs, sports, a good book, and is an expert procrastinator. She lives in Southern California with her family.

4 STARS
You . . . you are the biggest pain in my ass and the greatest love of my life.”

The third and final Sharpe brother is here and he was definitely worth the wait. Ford has been the rock of the Sharpe brothers, the stable one, the hardworking one. And now on the cusp of his father's book coming out after his passing, he's also the one spiraling. Need to get away from it all lands him at a hotel where a bout of bad weather locks him in for the night. There in the bar he meets a woman who changes everything, only he has no idea who she is and doesn't expect to see her again.

Ellery Sinclair has everything to prove. Her step brothers take constant credit for her ideas, and it's almost impossible to prove her worth to her stepfather. All she wants is something of her own. And then she finds the perfect opportunity, with the perfect hotel renovation, with the unlikeliest of business partners, Ford Sharpe.

If you're a fan of forced proximity, this one brings it in spades. Locked together for their business venture these two try as hard as they can to deny and avoid their incendiary chemistry. But it doesn't take long for it to finally get the best of them. I loved the way these two build each other up and bring out each other's best and worst. They challenge each other. They fight and they make up and I was so here for it. And even though I'm not usually a big fan of sweet contemporary, this one just hit the spot just right when it brought all the feels. And I particularly loved Ellery's love for romance books feature some very steamy scenes from Bromberg's previous books. That's a steamy cameo I couldn't get enough of.

4 'Just Ford' Stars!
ARC provided via Valentine PR in exchange for an honest review.


We are back with the Sharpe brothers and K. Bromberg is ending their series with another beautiful love story. I do believe this woman can write anything and I will sure love it. Final Proposal was no exception. The last book in this series is a one-night stand / workplace romance with another two incredible characters that you’ll love getting to know. Are you ready for the conclusion?

So, Final Proposal is the third and final installment in Kristy’s S.I.N series and it tells the story of the Sharpe middle twin, Fordham. Ford is having a rough night and he is not happy to be stranded in a bar full of strangers. Enter Ellery Sinclair, a mysterious sassy woman that will make this night the start of something neither expected. What they didn’t expect was crossing paths again and having to work together on a renovation project. Will this off-limits connection burn between Ford and Elle or will they be able to resist the temptation?

Desire. Need. Want. Greed. The four battled within me in those split seconds. Fuck decorum. Screw our partnership. The things that were going through my head were anything but partnership-amiable.

Another beautiful ending to another wonderful series from one of my top favorite authors! Of course, I am not surprised that Kristy gave us another Sharpe brother to fall in love with and another kickass heroine to sass the heck out of him. The chemistry between Ford and Ellery is intense from the very start and while circumstances are not easy for these two to act on it, the connection is too strong. I loved the depth of this couple, reading about their vulnerabilities and their love for their families and one another. I’ve fallen even more in love with all the crew we’ve met throughout the whole series and I am sure the fans will be pleased with the ending and this love story.

Fire’s got nothing on love.
On what you’d do for it.
On what you’d give for it.
On how bad you’ll burn for it.

Therefore, I am rating Final Proposal with 4 STARS because Bromberg gave the middle Sharpe brother the happy ending he deserved with a heroine to match him perfectly. Ford and Ellery were such a great couple. And as I said, I love everything this author writes and the S.I.N series is no exception. I do have to say the first book in the series was my favorite, but I do love them all and its outstanding characters. Get ready to fall in love with the Sharpe twins and the women who will bring them to their feet!

Fordham Sharpe is a successful businessman in Manhattan, and the middle son of identical triplets born to a billionaire hospitality mogul. Sharpe International is his legacy, and work and family are what matter most to him. S.I.N. is known for their sophisticated resorts and excellence, but lately Ford is restless, and in need of a break. When he ends up stranded at a hotel bar full of travelers trying to wait out a storm he meets a gorgeous, feisty stranger named Elle. Sparks fly and their easy conversation intrigues him. He’s enjoying being in the moment, and can’t remember a time he’s felt so alive.

Ellery Sinclair is an independent, confident woman working in a male dominated field. At Haywood Redesigns she’s constantly having to prove herself while clashing with her family. Then she crosses paths with a charming, genuine, seriously sexy guy named Ford. They hit it off and a friendship forms. Suddenly they are business partners working on a project together. There is just something about him that calls to her when he’s close. He’s irresistible and she can’t stop thinking about him, but he’s off limits. She needs to keep her distance so she doesn’t ruin this amazing opportunity, but he quickly becomes important to her. She doesn’t believe in happily ever afters, but there is something between them she wants more of. For a person who never lets her heart get invested, will she finally risk it all for love?



Final Proposal by K. Bromberg is the third book in the S.I.N. series about delicious triplets. This is a friends to lovers, forced proximity, office, beach romance full of chemistry, pleasure, emotion and humor. It’s a story about family, friendship, trust and beautiful connections. I have really enjoyed this series and love these sexy Sharpe brothers! <333

January 20, 2023
(audiobook) The story was just okay in my opinion, but with a couple of very interesting elements.

Ellery and Ford are like the mirror image of each other: both work at their family’s company; both have lost their parents; both have brothers. But they sure don’t have the same experience. While Ford has always been valued–at least he thought so until the beginning of the book–Ellery has been bullied by her misogynistic brothers. When they meet, they’re at a crossroads, and somehow they both think that buying the hotel where they spend the night talking is the solution to all their problems and the way to prove themselves. Which lead to a business partnership… and maybe more.

While they don’t admit it at first, the fact that that place means so much to them that they want to save it is revealing. I loved seeing them work together while managing their little fling.

I found Ford’s struggles after his father’s death quite compelling. Who doesn’t relate to someone looking for their parents’ approval. His closure was absolutely beautiful–though it could have happened way earlier in his story, saving him from so much suffering and doubt.

I was more dubious about Ellery’s struggles. Not that I didn’t understand why she wanted to prove herself–that was actually good, fighting the patriarchy and all that. But I really didn’t get why she refused to love. Her reasoning didn’t make sense in my opinion. And since it was the main source of the couple’s conflict, I just wanted to slap her.

Another tiny element in the story made me happy: the use of romance novels to spice up Ellery and Ford’s bed activities. It could have been ridiculous, but the author made it one of the hotest scenes in the story.

But really, what made the book more than acceptable was the narration. The female narrator did a great job, but the male narrator outdid himself in a couple of scenes. Quite an audiobook for a decent romance.

Quickie

- Series: SIN #3 (can be read as a standalone)
- Hashtags: #billionaire romance #office romance #forced proximity
- Triggers: past death
- Main couple: Ellery Sinclair & Fordham Sharpe
- Hotness: 4/5
- Romance: 4/5
- + I knew romance novels were useful
- – I didn’t buy Ellery’s hang ups

Final Proposal is the final book in the S.I.N trilogy about 3 hot billionaires brothers that happen to be triplets. These books have been hot, sexy and full of great chemistry between all the leads. BUT, I have to say, Fordham Sharpe may be my favorite. What is it about characters that have been hurt in the past that just gets me? And when it’s two of them?....I’m a goner.

2 strangers that are running away from problems at home end up getting caught in a storm where they have to wait it out in a lobby/bar of a rundown inn. Ford Sharpe has just discovered something in his father's book that doesn't sit right with him and he is feeling some sort of way, so he just needs time away from his brothers and out of the city. Meanwhile, Ellery Sinclair is done with her family. Her step brothers continuously knock her down and have given her no credit for her work and her stepfather does nothing to support her. She's ready to go out on her own and figure out her life on her terms. But getting caught in a storm with an attractive stranger was not in the plans.

Right from the beginning and their meet cute, I was in love with Ellery and Ford's chemistry. They had that je ne sais quoi. I'm so thankful that a rundown inn brought them together and ultimately reunited them in a venture that neither one of them saw coming. What follows is major sexual tension, close proximity, workplace romance with a scene of "there's only one bed" that was sexy as hell and full of vulnerability from two very strong and intelligent characters. But what really got me was seeing Ford being, well, just Ford. He has that charisma with just enough side of grumpy that made him delectable. Add in the fact that he is supportive and an amazing cheerleader for Ellery who needs it more now than ever. She hasn't had support like Fordham's since her parents and she honestly doesn't know what to do with it.

Elle and Ford are two damaged characters that form a friendship over time by working together and supporting one another. They work through their issues together, but Elle still keeps a piece of herself hidden away from Ford. That was the very small part that frustrated me a bit, but honestly, their attraction and banter more than made up for it. They were vulnerable and honest when it mattered most and the way they showed their love for one another was obvious. I enjoyed their journey to find each other and happiness with one another. Fordham the University and Celery Ellery were a team made in heaven. I absolutely love them as a couple, but I really love the relationship that Ford has with his brothers. That epilogue wrapped up the story perfectly. I'm sad this series is over, but am so thankful that Fordham and Ellery wrapped up the fun and sexy series with a side of emotional.

K. Bromberg once again packs a wallop in the three-book S.I.N. Series with the Final Proposal. Be ready to laugh out loud while reading this engaging romance.

It’s time for the last of the Sharpe identical triplets to get his turn in the spotlight. From the first installment, Fordham Sharpe has been my favorite. Oh! I liked Callahan and Ledger a lot – but Ford wins the top prize from start to finish. His story was a little different and, in my opinion, deeper and with more emotional entanglements. He really had some things to get off his chest.

It may take you a minute or two to warm up to our sassy and smart-as-a-whip heroine Ellery Sinclair, but you will love Ford from the start. This author has a gift for bestowing her readers with characters that mature as the story progresses. There’s plenty of clever and witty banter flying between Ford and Ellery but their romance is a bit of a slow burn. But when the sparks ignite, they burn the house down in a believable and well-developed romantic relationship. With family at its core, this story is rich with feelings that run the gamut.

It’s always a treat when the story is told from both sides of the table/bed. For me, getting points of view from each of the main characters completes the development of their individuality, personality, thoughts and feelings and brings their relationship to life.

An all-around perfect HAPPILY-EVER-AFTER that delighted with every turn of the page and left me with warm fuzzy feelings!

NOTE: All three books in the S.I.N. Series are now available on Kindle Unlimited.
Also, look for the beginning of a new sports-related series from Bromberg in April 2023 with The Player followed by The Catch in June 2023.

Final Proposal by K. Bromberg was all about stormy emotions, facing the demons inside and finding love in the most unexpected person. Fordham Sharpe surprised me in the best way possible. This alpha billionaire has vulnerabilities those will make you weak at knees and Ellery Sinclair is that kind of complex and fierce woman who was supposed to destroy his walls. Sexy. Heartfelt. Full of witty banter, sizzling hot chemistry and unforgettable characters; Final Proposal was a complete package.

Hotel tycoon Ford Sharpe was running from his issues and got stuck in a storm and in an old seasid inn. And he meets Ellery there. She fascinated him and their paths separated next morning. Only to cross again few days later at an auction where that inn was on sale and they were both trying to bid for it. It appears Ford isn't the only one with family issues and Ellery has to find her own space away from her stepbrother and her family business where she is never appreciated. They agree to be partners. All those days..staying in the inn undergoing renovation..can they resist their pull?


Ford has always come across this rock solid and level headed businessman in the previous books about his brother. He always tried to prove himself to his father who passed away years ago and that one line in his father's biography made him spiral out. My heart breaks for him. He is full with this resentment and anger and sometimes it appears his brothers are not getting his issues but that's not true. It will take some time for him to see it. Ellery has always been afraid to love as people she loved always left. But Ford just invaded her heart with his seductive charm, cocky arrogance, swoonworthy protectiveness and overall the super sexy way of respecting and appreciating her. For a brilliant, hard working and incredible woman starving for true attention and unconditional love, Ford was the kryptonite. It was a story of two somehow broken people. They had this witty, flirty and adorable friendship from the beginning. The passion and chemistry was burning slowly till it all exploded. They understood each other in unique way. And that happily ever after was well earned.

What a great finale to the S.I.N series. Fordham Sharpe or "Just Ford" stole my heart in this stormy, sexy and spicy romance that I devoured in one sitting.

I really loved these three brothers and their individual stories. Final Proposal was my personal favourite and a great addition to this series of stand-alones.

I loved the setting, the overall feel, the dynamics between the characters and their personal backstories. It was a perfect combination of everything I love in a book.

I couldn't put it down. I can't say there was anything unheard of in the story - two people partnering together under unusual circumstances but K. Bromberg's writing is so captivating and intriguing the pages seem to fly.

Ford and Ellery's banter, their cute nicknames for each other, their forbidden love and the chemistry were off the charts. They complemented each other so perfectly. I love all Bromberg women - strong, independent and ambitious, but always with a touch of self-doubt and vulnerability. And Ford was one of her good guys. Although he seemed rough and edgy at first, he knew how to empower a woman and give her the confidence to take out the best in her. He was definitely a dreamy book boyfriend.

Besides, I loved the dynamics in the Sharpe family. The love between the brothers although they had their differences was flowing from the pages. The appearances of both Ledger and Callahan and the glimpses in their lives were such an great addition to this story and made me smile. Their witty banter and the manly way they cared for each other definitely made me love the three hot triplets even more.

I enjoyed the slow build-up of romance and sexual tension in the story and the gradual reveal of feelings that were there from the start. The way they boosted the confidence of each other was admirable. And the spice level was definitely hot.

The ending was action packed and kept me on my toes. Definitely the cherry on the cake.

Another Bromberg's poignant story that had her trade mark of emotional, romantic, sexy and backed-up with two tortured main characters that managed to mend each other with love and devotion.

4.25stars--FINAL PROPOSAL is the third (and final?) instalment in K. Bromberg’s contemporary, adult S.IN. erotic, romance series focusing on the Sharpe Triplets-Callahan, Ford and Ledger. This is billionaire real estate developer Fordham ‘Ford’ Sharpe, and businesswoman Ellery Sinclair’s story line. FINAL PROPOSAL can be read as a stand alone without any difficulty. Any important information from the previous story line is revealed where necessary.

Told from dual first person perspectives (Ellery and Ford) using present day, and memories from the past, FINAL PROPOSAL follows in the aftermath of a storm that left two strangers among several others stranded at a small, run down roadside motel with plenty of potential. Fast forward several weeks, where the same two strangers, Ford Sharpe and Ellery Sinclair, would come face to face at a real estate auction, where our couple will battle one another for ownership of the rundown motel. Backing down, Ford all but gives Ellery the opportunity to buy the motel but will make her an offer she can not refuse. What ensues is the building romance and relationship between Ford and Ellery, as our couple work together in an effort to rebuild and re-establish a small motel into a part of the Sharpe Signature Collection of hotels and spas.

Ellery Sinclair’s life was spiralling out of control. Having lost both of her parents at an earlier age, raised by her step-father, and having to fight for a position within her extended family, Ellery finds herself wanting to venture on her own only to come up against the man with whom she would fall in love. Ellery struggles with the number of losses in her life, and continues to battle between head and heart as it pertains to falling in love with our story line hero. Fordham Sharpe is also struggling with his place in the family. The release of his late-father’s autobiography pushes Fordham to reconsider all that was and what will never be, believing himself to be the non-entity in a family of successful businessman.

The relationship between Ford and Ellery is one of immediate attraction but Ellery was recently involved with someone else. Keeping his distance was a struggle but Ford’s heart wanted something he knew he shouldn’t want. Ellery Sinclair has lost everyone she has ever loved and refuses to ever again go through the heartache of loss. When Ford proclaims his love, Ellery panics, and pushes our hero out of her life. The $ex scenes are intimate, erotic and passionate without the use of over the top, sexually graphic language and text.

The secondary and supporting characters include Ford’s brothers Ledger and Callahan, as well as several crew members, and Ellery’s extended family via memories and phone.

FINAL PROPOSAL is an impassioned story of love and loss, acceptance and moving forward. The premise is enjoyable and compelling; the romance is seductive and flirtatious; the characters are broken but struggling to move forward.

Final Proposal is the third and final book in the S.I.N. series. It can be read as a standalone. The author delivers another emotional story. Fordham Sharpe is the last of the triplets to find his happy ever after.

He meets Ellery Sinclair one night after an argument with his brothers. He and Ellery are stranded at a bar due to bad weather. They form a bond over the place, but she is gone when he wakes up in the morning. However, they meet again and form a business partnership.

Ford feels like the invisible son to his now deceased father. He does not like being referred to as "Just Ford", which was written in the book being published about his father's life. He doesn't want to do the press release for this book, which puts him at odds with his brothers.

Ellery doesn't believe in love or happy ever afters. She never reads the epilogues in the romance novels she reads. Everyone she loves has left her in some way. As much as she cares for Ford, she doesn't want to put that curse on him.

There are some short flashback scenes woven throughout the story to help get a better understanding of why Ellery and Ford are the way they are. I'm not big on flashbacks, but these are short enough and handled really well.

I loved that the author used excerpts of her own previous books for the love scenes Ellery is reading on her kindle.

Thank you to the author and Valentine PR for an advanced readers copy. All thoughts and opinions are my own.
